impact_assessment.why: Build VoidFarer: an autonomous deep-space fleet, procedural galaxy, and holographic cockpit simulation engine with zero external dependencies
impact_assessment.benefits: Provides an engaging, high-fidelity procedural simulation engine, rich CLI, and breathtaking Web Audio/Canvas holographic cockpit HUD while adhering 100% to AIKit principles
impact_assessment.risks: contract: REST API and CLI schema alignment; dependency: zero external packages allowed; concurrency: multi-threaded HTTP server and state atomicity; state: power-loss safe storage
impact_assessment.mitigation: Frozen dataclass contracts, Python standard library only, thread-safe state mutex with atomic replace, and comprehensive sub-second test suite

checkpoints.description: [2/6] Core simulation models, procedural galaxy, and CLI REPL implemented
